result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation in a food delivery app interface.

issues.description: The third item in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge, showing truncated text and a partially visible card.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontal scroll carousel, but ensure the truncation is intentional and the card peek indicates scrollability. Consider showing a clearer scroll affordance.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without an ellipsis clearly indicating more content, which may confuse users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncation uses a proper ellipsis and the full name is accessible on scroll or tap.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing only the image without full details.
issues.suggestion: This is normal scroll behavior, but verify adequate padding above the bottom nav so content is not permanently obscured when scrolled to the end.
